translations.web: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
translations.bsb: He gives them a sense of security, but His eyes are on their ways.
translations.kjv: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
translations.asv: God giveth them to be in security, and they rest thereon; And his eyes are upon their ways.
